title: National Human Rights Institutions (NHRIs) and Global Compliance

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Under the UN Paris Principles, a National Human Rights Institution (*nemzeti emberi jogi intézmény*) must possess complete constitutional, operational, and financial independence from the government.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: During the UN Universal Periodic Review (*Egyetemes Időszakos Felülvizsgálat / UPR*), every state's human rights record is examined every 4.5 years in Geneva by peer nations, civil society coalitions, and international rapporteurs.
